name: How do financing options for a duplex differ from a single-family home?

mainEntity.name: How do financing options for a duplex differ from a single-family home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financing a duplex often involves different considerations than a single-family home, as lenders assess the property's income-generating potential. You might qualify for conventional loans, FHA loans (if you plan to occupy one unit), or even commercial loans for larger multi-unit properties. Lenders will typically review projected rental income as part of your debt-to-income ratio. Kelby Contreras can connect you with experienced lenders in South Florida who understand the specifics of duplex financing and can guide you through the pre-approval process tailored to investment properties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing a duplex can involve conventional, FHA, or commercial loans, with lenders often considering projected rental income. It's important to work with lenders experienced in investment properties.
